fields.climate: tropical marine; rainy season (November to May)
fields.terrain: volcanic islands, interiors vary from steep mountains to low hills
fields.hazards: cyclones possible during rainy season (December to April); volcanic activity on Grand Comore; volcanism: Karthala (2,361 m) on Grand Comore Island last erupted in 2007; a 2005 eruption forced thousands of people to be evacuated and produced a large ash cloud
fields.farm: bananas, coconuts, cassava, yams, maize, taro, milk, tomatoes, sweet potatoes, pulses
fields.exports: cloves, ships, essential oils, vanilla, scrap iron
fields.languages: Arabic (official), French (official), Shikomoro (official; similar to Swahili), Comorian
fields.religions: Muslim 98.1% (overwhelmingly Sunni Muslim, small Shia Muslim and Ahmadiyya Muslim populations), ethnic religionist 1.1%, Christian 0.6%, other 0.3%
fields.legal: mixed legal system of Islamic religious law, the French civil code of 1975, and customary law
fields.military: 18-25 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription
